brief.t: FIRST — Terra Lotus: $78,580, or 52% of the $150K monthly target, has sat unsent since Aug 2. Provide the contact name plus shipping and billing addresses, approve the contract and tiered quote, then send it today. This is the biggest revenue lever — do not start anything else before it.

SECOND — Atlas Eternal: the $26,500 agreement and pro forma are ready. Confirm Aiden Kraim's Adobe-document wording, fill the three placeholders — fill size and packaging, billing address, and lead time and Incoterms — then approve and send. Terra plus Atlas is $105,080, about 70% of the monthly target.

THIRD — Website and forms, the agent-owned lane, is in progress. Contact forms are verified delivering to sam@prvtlabellabs.com, the SEO-agency form is disabled, and the address is migrated. The real gaps: Book a Call has no scheduler wired and hCaptcha may be silently dropping leads. Waiting on Sam's booking URL — he has one, but it does not attach a Google Meet link. The agent is building hardened forms on a draft theme; nothing publishes without Sam's approval.

FOURTH — OpenSend still needs the noon green light: three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking-calendar URL, and ICP Tier A. Every delay pushes the two-to-three-week warmup clock.

FIFTH — Restore the PLL CRM session as pll_tasklet_consultant. It blocks CRM fix verification, Aidan's purchasing knowledge-base extraction, and UnShrink It verification; do not treat old dashboard numbers as live until access is back.
SIXTH — Aidan still needs to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so his 7 AM brief captures CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of being Outlook-only.
SEVENTH — Nadia/Oreka: secure approval of the $8,555 payment and keep the 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job moving. This is the next cash-and-production follow-up once the two contracts are sent.

kb.a: Terra Lotus is a $78,580 manufacturing opportunity, equal to 52% of the $150K monthly target. The contract and tiered quote have been unsent since Aug 2; Sam must provide the contact name plus shipping and billing addresses, approve both documents, and send them today. Nothing should outrank this. No Terra Lotus reply arrived overnight.

Atlas Eternal is a $26,500 opportunity with its agreement and pro forma ready to send. Before release, confirm Aiden Kraim's Adobe-document wording and fill the three placeholders: fill size and packaging, billing address, and lead time and Incoterms. Sam then approves and sends. No Atlas reply arrived overnight.

The website and forms lane is agent-owned and in progress. Contact forms are verified delivering to sam@prvtlabellabs.com, the SEO-agency form is disabled, and the address is migrated. The real gaps are that Book a Call has no scheduler wired and hCaptcha may be silently dropping leads. The agent is waiting on Sam's booking URL — he has one but it does not attach a Google Meet link — and is building hardened forms on a draft theme. Nothing publishes without Sam's approval.

OpenSend needs Sam's noon approval for three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate PLL Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking-calendar URL, and ICP Tier A. Domain and inbox warmup takes about two to three weeks, so any delay today delays pipeline creation.

The PLL CRM browser session is signed out at the login screen. Restoring pll_tasklet_consultant access is needed for CRM fix verification, Aidan's purchasing knowledge-base extraction, and UnShrink It verification. Today's carried CRM dashboard figures are not live verification.

Aidan's Command Lab is live and self-publishing its brief at 7 AM. It still needs Aidan to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so it can incorporate CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of relying on Outlook only.
Nadia/Oreka needs $8,555 payment approval and the next handoff for a 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job. Treat this as the next cash-and-production follow-up once Terra and Atlas are sent.

Victor Armendarez has a 4,000-unit, two-SKU opportunity: Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel. The quote still needs confirmed packaging, fill, labor, and overhead costs; do not issue pricing until the cost basis is complete.
Tiffany requires a call before travel. The immediate commercial objective and exact timing are not verified in current sources, so confirm both on the call rather than inventing a commitment.

Yorel, founder of Hubs & Babydoll, is a multi-product manufacturing inquiry covering body oils, beard products, body butter, and body wash. Sales requested quantity, inventory budget, formula needs, brand assets, and WhatsApp availability before scheduling a consultation. No value is verified yet.

Hina at Heirloom is seeking frosted-style packaging for a 2,500-piece peptide cream run with silk-screened lids and secondary boxes. She is connected with Laura for container sourcing, and the Heirloom container meeting is set for Tuesday, Aug 11 at 10 AM ET. Bring current container options.

Alex at Shopokami wants wholesale per-unit pricing for the Whipped Body Butter with Beef Tallow at 50, 100, and 250 units. He asked Sam to call him directly at +1 514-242-7072 rather than meet by Google Meet. Sam explained per-unit pricing is not listed publicly because it moves with quantity, jar size, and label finish; this is a live conversation awaiting Sam's pricing follow-up.

Overnight inbound awaiting replies: Keyshaun Butler confirmed he is still interested; Hass Alamer, a Manhattan stylist, detailed two hero hair-care products (a leave-in conditioner and a styling cream) after Sam's reply; and two Shopify contact-form leads came in — Natalie Hamilton and Tamara Danielsen, who wants confirmation all products are USA-made. None are angry; all are warm leads needing follow-up after Terra and Atlas.

As of the 6:30 AM ET Ads refresh, current 7-day spend is $219.68 versus $154.37 the prior 7 days, with today at $1.50 partial. An overnight Ads alert flagged the first weekly cap breach with an approval needed to move ContractMfg to Manual CPC; the Ads agent made no changes and the item awaits Sam's decision.
Sam's lane today is Terra Lotus first, Atlas Eternal second, then the noon OpenSend decision. Do not switch to facility, website, or lower-value work until the Terra package is sent.
